items.title: Define authorized-but-bounded launch metadata artifact
items.context: Add a small Multi-Model M2 authorization artifact that records humanApproval, dated snapshots, prompt/tool digests, runner ownership, duplicate policy, sequencing limits, and B-11be provider budget cap USD 0.00. Approved scope is metadata/checker/docs for the next formal cell 03 calibration boundary only; real provider cell execution requires a later story with a separate nonzero budget cap.
items.userSees: Terminal/status output contains: "M2-provider authorization metadata: Done", "Provider spend in B-11be: USD 0.00", "Provider cells run in B-11be: none", and "Cell 06 A2prime: blocked".

happy.desc: m2-provider-execution-authorization.json exists and records human approval, USD 0.00 provider budget cap, metadata-only scope, and cell 03 as the next formal step.

edge.desc: Authorization artifact keeps providerCallEnabled=false, formalPhase1UseAllowed=false, and containsOutcomeData=false for B-11be.

adversarial.desc: Authorization artifact does not treat host labels as provider model snapshots and does not unblock cell 06.

verificationEvidence.note: Checker loads m2-provider-execution-authorization.json and verifies B-11be metadata authorization, human approval marker, USD 0.00 provider budget cap, and cell 03 as the next formal step.
Checker verifies providerCallEnabled=false, formalPhase1UseAllowed=false, containsOutcomeData=false, no result rows, no outcome records, and no provider calls for B-11be.
Checker rejects host-label-only snapshot acceptance, nonzero budget, providerCallEnabled=true, real provider execution, outcome records path, and cell 06 unblocking.

items.title: Update provider execution checker for authorization metadata
items.context: Teach the checker to distinguish accidental unauthorized providerExecutionAuthorized=true from a valid metadata-only authorized-but-bounded artifact. For B-11be, the valid state is local metadata authorization with providerCallEnabled=false, budget cap USD 0.00, cell 03 as next formal step, and cell 06 blocked until a real cell-03-derived budget lock from a later provider-execution story.
excludes: accepting host labels as model snapshots
items.userSees: Terminal/checker output contains: "M2 provider execution checker passed", "nextPermittedFormalStep=cell-03-calibration", "cell-06-a2prime-blocked", and "no provider calls made".

happy.desc: node experiments/multi-model-ablation/m2-provider-execution-check.mjs passes with the metadata-only authorization artifact present.

edge.desc: Checker rejects missing required metadata fields and keeps cell 06 blocked without a real cell-03-derived budget lock.

adversarial.desc: Checker rejects host-label-only snapshots, provider fallback, providerCallEnabled runners, and outcome/result record paths in B-11be.

verificationEvidence.note: Checker passes with m2-provider-execution-authorization.json present and prints the required terminal status lines.
Checker keeps cell 06 blocked without a real cell-03-derived budget lock and verifies missing real execution metadata still blocks provider execution.
Checker rejects providerCallEnabled runners, host-label-only snapshots, provider fallback, nonzero budget, outcome/result record paths, and cell 06 unblocking.

items.title: Update M2 status documentation and visible milestone table
items.context: Update local status docs so future agents see that B-11be records local authorization metadata with provider spend capped at USD 0.00, provider result data absent, and cell 03 remaining the only next formal provider-execution step for a later separately budgeted story.
excludes: claiming provider execution happened in B-11be
items.userSees: The status docs visibly show: "M2-provider authorization metadata: DONE", "provider spend USD 0.00", "no provider cells ran", "no result rows exist", "cell 03 is next", and "cell 06 remains blocked".

happy.desc: m2-status.md and README mention the authorization artifact and show M2-provider metadata as Done/Prepared without claiming provider execution results.

edge.desc: Docs keep H-M1/H-M3, model-agnostic wording, product gates, and paper claims locked until real result rows exist.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not imply full Phase 1 authorization, cell 06 unblocked, provider calls made, or product-gate impact.
